usedFor: Copilot holds your portal clients and HubSpot holds your deals, so “New Client” can run “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Copilot, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new portal client opens a deal in HubSpot, so sales follow-up starts as soon as the client exists.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID, so use “Create Deal” for new clients and keep updates separate.
